title: Explo's G2 Spring 2025 Awards
summary: Explo named G2’s Spring 2025 “Momentum Leader” and #1 in Usability, Customer Relationship, and Implementation for Data Visualization
body_markdown:
We’re thrilled to share that Explo has once again been recognized as a top performer in G2’s Spring 2025 report, earning **30 badges** across Embedded Business Intelligence and Data Visualization categories.


### Here are some of the Spring 2025 highlights:


✅ **Ranked #3** in Small-Business Americas for Embedded Business Intelligence
✅ **#1 out of 52** in Usability for Data Visualization
✅ **#1 out of 81** in Customer Relationship for Data Visualization
✅ **#1 out of 51** in Implementation for Data Visualization
✅ **99%** likelihood to recommend
✅ **99%** quality of support
✅ **99%** ease of use
✅ Net Promoter Score of **97**


Explo continues to outperform industry leaders like Microsoft Power BI, Tableau, and Looker, maintaining our position as a **Momentum Leader in Embedded Business Intelligence** for the **second consecutive year** .


In G2’s Spring 2025 report, Explo earned top marks in customer satisfaction, ease of use, and implementation — proving once again that delivering a seamless, developer-friendly experience matters.


> “We’re incredibly proud to see our continued focus on customer experience and usability reflected in G2’s Spring 2025 report,” said Andrew Chen, co-founder of Explo. “We’re committed to empowering teams with flexible, scalable embedded analytics that just work — so they can focus on delivering better customer experiences.”


Unlike traditional BI tools that are difficult to integrate and clunky for end users, Explo was purpose-built for product teams. Whether you’re embedding dashboards, reports, or self-service analytics, Explo makes it easy to get powerful insights into the hands of your customers — fast.


These rankings are based on **verified reviews from real users** . G2’s Grid® Scores represent the collective voice of the software community, and we’re honored to have earned top scores from the customers who matter most.


### **What customers are saying:**

Explo powers customer-facing analytics for SaaS companies, enabling teams to deliver embedded dashboards and reports that scale.
